## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian personal-finance podcast episode (VG's Pengerådet) about Norges Bank raising its policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4.5%. The hosts explain how and when banks will pass the hike on to mortgage rates (after the 8-week notice period, so full effect around December), the after-tax cost per million of debt, and how annuity loans soften the hit. They also give practical advice: compare banks, negotiate, and consider Statens pensjonskasse loans. The only company named is DNB, as the bank expected to announce first. No equity views or investment calls are given.
